messages:
Alex (AE): FYI NimbusHealth POC: nightly evals of 12k docs are intermittently failing with 401s and some timeouts. Acceptance window is tight (target GA decision by 2026-03-30).
Sam (Solutions): Can you drop a sample error and confirm which pipeline stage? embeddings, rerank, or redaction?
Alex (AE): Pipeline: PHI redaction -> embeddings -> semantic search. Sample from last run:
```
2026-03-20T03:04:11Z ERROR 401 unauthorized token invalid
2026-03-20T03:04:18Z WARN token refresh attempt failed: 502
2026-03-20T03:05:02Z ERROR 504 gateway timeout
```
Kevin (SE): Sounds like token rotation races + occasional upstream latency. Are they using short-lived rotated tokens (CI runner) or a long-lived service key for the batch job?
Alex (AE): They rotate creds every 60m via their infra team. Nimbus policy demands BYO-KMS for prod and HSM-backed keys eventually.
Priya (Security): Quick note: BYO-HSM is only supported on Private or Dedicated with HSM integration. Hosted cannot provide customer HSM. That impacts compliance asks.
Jordan (Eng-runtime): We just merged a retry tweak but it hasn't rolled everywhere. If they hit token refresh during a large parallel job, you can see 401s followed by 502/504 from the upstream auth proxy.
Sam (Solutions): Short-term options: 1) run the nightly eval against a Dedicated staging pool and pin a token for the job, 2) reduce concurrency on the eval runner, 3) add a client-side retry/refresh shim. Each has cost/timeline tradeoffs.
Alex (AE): Nimbus prefers the fastest path to acceptance. How long to stand up a Dedicated staging pool? Any pricing implications?
Maria (sales): (jumping in) Dedicated staging for 2 weeks is possible; ballpark ~$5-7k, plus a small setup SOW amendment. Private + HSM is larger and 2-3 weeks lead time.
Kevin (SE): Engineering recommendation for stability test config:
- client retries = 6 with jitter
- disable continuous batching for the large async job to avoid KV cache pressure
- pin model `open-embed-XL-v2` and limit concurrency to 3
Curl check for auth header:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["sample note"]}'
```
Alex (AE): I tried pinning token + retries locally — failures dropped from ~1% to ~0.2% but still not zero. Uploading logs to the ticket.
Jordan (Eng-runtime): Please include failing request IDs; we can trace the auth proxy lifecycle. We're also testing a small patch to avoid a refresh race. deploy-bot: deployed `auth-refresh-backoff` to staging at 2026-03-20T06:12Z
Sam (Solutions): If the patch looks good, we can push it to the Dedicated pool before the full 12k run. If not, a manual rotation shim will be needed.
Priya (Security): For Nimbus acceptance we should produce a checklist to sign off on. Draft checklist idea:
- Full-run of 12k docs with documented failures <= 0.1% transient (and remediation steps)
- Audit logs exported (immutable) and retained for 30 days
- KMS/HSM integration roadmap with dates or contractual exception for interim
- Performance targets: median embedding latency <350ms, p95 <800ms
- Data residency confirmation + contractual addendum
Alex (AE): Client success criteria also added: redaction F1 >= .92, semantic recall@10 >= .86. We'll attach the prompt/eval seed versions to the POC ticket.
Maria (sales): Commercially, we can offer Dedicated staging as a short-term paid workaround while KMS is scheduled. Need Nimbus legal OK for hosted interim if they want faster onboarding.
Kevin (SE): Operational caveat: turning off continuous batching reduces efficiency and increases cost but avoids long-lived KV contention that can surface during large async runs. Recommend smoke runs at 500/2k before full run.
Alex (AE): I'll propose Dedicated staging + retry config as the recommended POC path and share the acceptance checklist. Will ask Nimbus to approve the budget for 2-week staging.
Jordan (Eng-runtime): Once you have failing IDs, tag me. If the patch reduces failures to acceptable thresholds, we can sign off and schedule KMS work for GA.
Alex (AE): Thanks all — updating Nimbus and attaching the eval script, seeds, and current logs to the POC. Will reopen thread if new 401s show up after the staging deploy.
